ns2:section.sectionText: NGOs play an increasingly important role in global development. In an era where state provision of services has been sidelines in many countries, international and local NGOs have often been called on to fill gaps in areas like rural development, adult basic education, public health, and a range of poverty alleviation strategies. The presence of NGOs has been particularly marked in post-disaster situations. For example the entry of such a large number of NGOs into Haiti in the wake of the 2011 earthquake has prompted some observers to label the country, the ?Republic of the NGOs.? In this course we will examine the practice of such NGOS, assess their impact and reflect on the role NGOs might play in the future of development.
